Meet Olga

Photographer.
Creator. Guide.

Olga is a photographer with over 12 years of experience and the founder of Snowdrop Photography and Emotional Canvas. She believes creativity has the power to help people express themselves, reconnect with themselves, and create beauty in their lives.

Through photography, AI, and immersive workshops, she creates experiences that bring together art, technology, and human connection — always with warmth, intention, and a deep belief in the creative power inside every person.

12+Years in photography
500+Women in workshops
DCBased in NOVA & DC
Her philosophy

Art is for everyone.

You don’t need to call yourself an artist to create something beautiful. You just need permission to try.

Technology as a creative tool.

AI doesn’t replace creativity — it amplifies it. Olga teaches women to use AI as a paintbrush, not a shortcut.

Community over competition.

Every workshop fosters genuine connection. The best thing you might make is a new friendship.
